faqs.question: What is the official WhatsApp Business API in Brazil, and how is it different from unofficial tools?
faqs.answer:
• The official WhatsApp Business API, also called the WhatsApp Business Platform, is Meta's solution for businesses that want to communicate with customers at scale. It supports bulk campaigns, AI chatbots, multiple agents on one number, and integrations with websites and CRM systems.
  • Unlike unofficial tools that depend on QR codes or WhatsApp Web sessions, the WhatsApp Business API uses Meta's approved messaging infrastructure for more reliable business communication.
  • With MSG91, Brazilian businesses can access WhatsApp Business API at rates lower than Meta's standard pricing, automate conversations without coding, and manage customer interactions from one platform.

faqs.question: Why should Brazilian businesses choose MSG91 as their WhatsApp Business API provider?
faqs.answer:
• Running a business is already complicated. Customer communication shouldn't be. MSG91 combines competitive pricing, easy automation, and customer support tools in one platform.
  • Brazilian businesses get WhatsApp messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard USD list rates, along with a no-code dashboard for campaigns and chatbots.
  • MSG91 goes beyond WhatsApp. With One API, businesses can manage communication across WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, email, and voice without building separate integrations for every channel.
  • You also get AI chatbots and MSG91 Hello, a shared inbox where teams can manage customer conversations together.
  • Trusted by 30,000+ businesses globally, MSG91 helps businesses simplify communication while keeping costs under control.

faqs.question: How much does WhatsApp Business API cost in Brazil?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing has two parts: messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard USD pricing for Brazil.
  • MSG91's Brazil messaging rates are:
    • Marketing: $0.05644 per message
    • Utility: $0.00614 per message
    • Authentication: $0.00614 per message
    • Service: $0.00614 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs $7/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, 10,000 billable marketing messages cost $564.40 with MSG91, compared with $625 at Meta's standard USD list rate, saving $60.60 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • Actual savings depend on message volume, applicable pricing tiers, and billing arrangements.
  • Compare the MSG91 Brazil pricing plans with Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform pricing.

faqs.question: Is MSG91 a secure and trusted WhatsApp Business API provider in Brazil?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. Security and reliability are essential when managing customer communication. MSG91 is SOC 2 Type II audited, reflecting independently assessed security controls and processes for protecting business information.
  • MSG91 also has 200+ reviews on G2 across its products and is trusted by 30,000+ businesses worldwide.
  • With Meta's official WhatsApp Business API infrastructure, businesses can manage customer conversations, automation, and integrations through a trusted communication platform.
  • Explore MSG91's security and compliance documentation.

faqs.question: Can Brazilian businesses send bulk WhatsApp campaigns for Black Friday without getting blocked?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. Brazilian businesses can use MSG91 to run Black Friday, Natal, Dia das Mães, and other seasonal WhatsApp marketing campaigns without building a custom API integration.
  • With MSG91, you can upload opted-in contacts through CSV files, personalise approved templates with images and offers, schedule campaigns, and track delivery performance.
  • For example, a fashion retailer in São Paulo can send Black Friday offers with product images, discounts, and shopping links to subscribed customers.
  • MSG91 also supports opt-out management, helping customers unsubscribe from unwanted promotions.
  • Businesses must follow Meta's messaging policies and Brazil's Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD). Using the API does not guarantee that an account will never face restrictions.
  • Explore MSG91 Campaign to automate customer engagement across channels.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 AI WhatsApp chatbots reply in Brazilian Portuguese and handle e-commerce enquiries?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 AI-powered WhatsApp chatbots can communicate in Brazilian Portuguese and combine rule-based steps with AI-powered conversations within a single bot. Businesses don't need separate bots for predefined workflows and intelligent responses.
  • The chatbot can connect with 2,000+ apps, make API calls, and use connected business information to handle everything from FAQs and order tracking to product recommendations, returns, and more complex customer enquiries.
  • Businesses can also choose from multiple AI models and configure backup models to help maintain conversation continuity if the primary model becomes unavailable.
  • For example, a Brazilian online store can use one bot to guide customers through predefined steps, recommend products using AI, check live order details through APIs, and assist with returns.
  • When human assistance is needed, the chatbot transfers the conversation to an agent through MSG91 Hello, where teams manage enquiries from a shared inbox.
  • Explore MSG91 WhatsApp Chatbots, the Shopify integration guide, and the Hello mobile application.

faqs.question: How can businesses in Brazil reduce WhatsApp customer support costs after Meta's October 2026 pricing changes?
faqs.answer:
• Since October 1, 2026, Meta has charged for WhatsApp service messages beyond the monthly free allowance. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number remain free each month, while additional billable messages cost $0.00614 each with MSG91 in Brazil.
  • Utility templates sent within an active customer service window also became chargeable, subject to Meta's exceptions.
  • For businesses answering hundreds of enquiries daily, these costs can add up.
  • MSG91 Chat Window provides a more cost-effective way to continue conversations: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • A customer starts on WhatsApp and opens a dedicated Chat Window through a link. AI chatbots or human agents then continue helping through Hello without sending every reply via WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window do not incur Meta's WhatsApp messaging charges. Messages sent through WhatsApp remain chargeable.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide to learn how it works.

faqs.question: Can businesses send WhatsApp OTPs to customers in Brazil using MSG91?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 allows Brazilian businesses to send WhatsApp OTPs for account verification, logins, and other eligible authentication workflows.
  • Authentication messages to Brazilian numbers cost $0.00614 each with MSG91, below Meta's standard USD list rate of $0.00680.
  • What if a customer doesn't receive the OTP? The MSG91 OTP Widget supports configurable resend and fallback options across SMS, WhatsApp, voice, and email, depending on the selected setup.
  • This is particularly useful for fintech applications, online stores, and digital services where customers need to verify their identity before continuing.
  • Businesses can configure supported OTP workflows through the dashboard or integrate them using MSG91 APIs.
  • Explore the MSG91 OTP Widget and its integration guide.

faqs.question: Which industries in Brazil benefit most from WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer:
• Businesses that handle frequent customer enquiries, transactions, and follow-ups can benefit significantly from WhatsApp Business API automation.
  • Some of the most relevant industries in Brazil include:
    • E-commerce and retail: Recover abandoned carts, send order updates, and automate seasonal campaigns.
    • Fintech and digital banking: Send OTPs, payment notifications, and account updates.
    • Travel and hospitality: Confirm reservations, answer guest enquiries, and share booking information.
    • Healthcare and clinics: Manage appointment reminders, scheduling enquiries, and routine administrative support.
    • Real estate: Qualify property leads, answer listing questions, and schedule visits.
  • With MSG91, these businesses can connect WhatsApp to their existing workflows through Shopify, supported integrations, or custom APIs.
  • AI chatbots handle repetitive conversations while human agents focus on customers who need personalised assistance.
  • Explore MSG91 Hello to see how businesses can manage customer conversations across teams.

  • From your first setup to everyday operations, MSG91 keeps your communication and support connected.
